strings.Философия DS PROAUDIO: свой путь в разра: The DS PROAUDIO philosophy: our own path in engineering, care for everyone who works with our equipment, and sound without a signature coloration of its own.
strings.Мы с большим уважением относимся к нашим: We have deep respect for our peers at other manufacturers, especially those who change the industry and set its quality standards. We study their experience closely and admire their breakthroughs.
strings.Но у нас свой путь — мы никогда не повто: But we follow our own path. We never copy other people’s solutions: even when a technology catches our interest, we rebuild it from scratch until we arrive at a better result.
strings.Мы — большая команда единомышленников, г: We are a large team of like-minded people, and each of us puts our best into the common cause.
strings.И мы заботимся обо всех, кто соприкасает: And we care about everyone who touches our equipment at every stage of its life cycle: not only the listener, but also the sound engineers, system engineers and installation partners.

strings.Юрий Михайлович Старченко родился в Лени: Yuri Starchenko was born in Leningrad in 1954.
strings.Музыка всегда играла важную роль в его ж: Music has always played an important part in his life, and that may well be where his passion for acoustics began. He has devoted nearly 50 years to this fascinating field, with a degree from the Leningrad Electrotechnical Institute behind him.
strings.Его путь начался ещё в советское время с: His path began back in Soviet times, repairing loudspeakers.
strings.Затем судьба привела его к участию в соз: Later he helped build what became the largest manufacturer of professional loudspeaker equipment in the former Soviet Union.
strings.Компания гордилась тем, что её разработк: The company was proud that its designs were in demand not only in Russia but abroad: it worked with European and American companies and represented the country at international trade shows in Frankfurt and Los Angeles.
strings.В 2000 году Юрий Михайлович основал собс: In 2000, Yuri founded his own manufacturing company. Alongside civilian loudspeaker equipment, the company also handles defense contracts, supplying products for the Ministry of Defense and other government agencies.
strings.Уже 25 лет он с гордостью руководит этим: He has proudly led it for 25 years.
strings.Главным достижением за это время Юрий Ми: He considers his greatest achievement to be building a team of engineers unique in Russia.
strings.Компании удалось выстроить производство: The company built full-cycle production, from winding a voice coil to building complex line arrays.
strings.В начале 2019 года Юрий Михайлович с энт: In early 2019, Yuri enthusiastically backed the idea of reviving the production of concert sound equipment.
strings.Так и появилась компания DS PROAUDIO, в: That is how DS PROAUDIO came about. He sees it as the embodiment of his lifelong passion for acoustics and his drive to create the highest-quality sound for everyone.
strings.Вячеслав Моцар – директор по развитию ко: Vyacheslav Motsar is Business Development Director at DS PROAUDIO, an entrepreneur and a musician whose passion for music is inseparable from the world of pro audio.
strings.В своей жизни он руководствуется принцип: He lives by the principles in his favorite sayings: “Fortune favors the bold” and “The road is conquered by those who walk it.” These words keep him striving for new achievements and always moving forward.
strings.Погружение Вячеслава в мир Pro-аудио нач: Vyacheslav’s journey into pro audio started with music. He studied violin and piano at music school, then taught himself guitar and drums.
strings.Играя в рок-группе, он в какой-то момент: Playing in a rock band, at some point he wanted to capture his musical ideas. That meant learning sound recording, so that his music would not be lost to posterity.
strings.Со временем сам процесс звукозаписи стал: Over time, the recording process itself became as rewarding as the result. Mastering the gear, studying the parameters, understanding how every knob shapes the sound: all of this drew him into a completely different side of the music industry.
strings.И, как логичное продолжение, Вячеслав пр: As a natural next step, Vyacheslav joined a company that sold and installed sound equipment. He found the field fascinating, and in 2009 he founded his own company, Deep Sound.
strings.С тех пор компания оснастила десятки объ: Since then, Deep Sound has equipped dozens of venues of every size and complexity, mastered system design and visualization, and built a team of talented, dedicated specialists.
strings.Когда Вячеславу предложили не просто «пр: When Vyacheslav was invited not just to sell equipment but to help create it, he gladly accepted and threw himself into the work. It let him combine his two greatest passions, gear and creativity, from an unexpected and very exciting angle.
strings.В DS PROAUDIO Вячеслав отвечает за превр: At DS PROAUDIO, Vyacheslav is responsible for turning great loudspeakers into a great product and for getting the word about it to as many people as possible.
strings.Он руководит концепцией новых продуктов,: He leads new product concepts, works with partners and engineers, and oversees technical support, service, documentation and supply planning.
strings.Этот комплекс действий направлен на то,: All of this aims to make sure our loudspeaker systems not only sound great but are also convenient and pleasant to work with at every stage.

strings.Николай Мильков родился и вырос в Ленинг: Nikolay Milkov was born and raised in Leningrad, now St. Petersburg.
strings.Всё началось с музыки. С 15 лет Николай: It all started with music. From the age of 15 Nikolay played bass in a band, and by 18 he knew exactly what he wanted to do with his life. He called a loudspeaker factory outside St. Petersburg himself, and was turned down.
strings.Но через пять лет, в 2004 году, он сдела: Five years later, in 2004, he tried again and joined Yuri Starchenko’s company. After four years of work combined with constant study, Nikolay was designing new loudspeaker systems on his own, and by 2013 he had developed several unique solutions for special applications and become one of the company’s co-owners.
strings.С тех пор Николай является главным конст: Since then, Nikolay has been chief designer in two fields at once: professional audio, and specialized public address and acoustic test equipment.
strings.На его счету уже пять действующих патент: He holds five active patents for acoustic devices and technologies (three of them used in DS PROAUDIO production models). He has also delivered several large, one-of-a-kind high-SPL acoustic test projects for leading aerospace companies, set up series production of HF compression drivers, and written acoustic simulation software.
strings.В 2019 году Николай первым сформулировал: In 2019, Nikolay was the first to put forward the idea of a new brand, a manufacturer of professional loudspeaker systems, and found a partner in Moscow, Vyacheslav Motsar. Together they launched DS PROAUDIO.
strings.Для нового проекта Николай разработал вс: For the new venture, Nikolay designed the entire product range, covering acoustics as well as mechanics and rigging.
strings.Сегодня он продолжает разрабатывать новы: Today he keeps developing new products, now together with a much larger team of like-minded people, and plays an active role in growing the DS PROAUDIO brand and shaping the company’s strategy, goals and philosophy.
strings.Посвятил работе в музыкальной индустрии: He has devoted more than 50 years to the music industry, building up unique experience and knowledge.

strings.Этим предприятием была EVM — бренд, кото: That company was EVM, a brand known in the 90s to practically everyone in the pro audio business. EVM was replacing imports with domestic products long before anyone talked about sanctions; it exported actively and had offices in Los Angeles (EVM-USA) and Nice (EVM-France). Back then, “made in Russia” really meant made, not just assembled. Production of the first branded drivers was set up as a joint venture with specialists from the American company McCauley, which went on to become a regular EVM customer. The legendary Genelec 1035A studio monitor was built with Russian drivers, and a collaboration with the German HF driver maker BMS added LF and MF drivers to the BMS range, drivers that world-famous companies such as L-Acoustics use to this day.
strings.Но в конце 1990-х компания, к тому момен: But in the late 1990s the company, which by then held substantial assets, fell victim to a hostile corporate raid and effectively ceased to exist as Russia’s largest loudspeaker manufacturer.

strings.2022 год стал для отрасли переломным: ух: 2022 was a turning point for the industry. The departure of Western brands sharply raised interest in Russian manufacturers, but it also confronted DS PROAUDIO with a serious challenge: the company lost its supply of German HF drivers.
